create_TextVideoDataset: create a TextVideoDataset subclass to load video-text pairs with configurable frame sampling and transforms
sample_frames: sample frame indices from a video using random, uniform, or fixed start strategies
read_frames_decord: read video frames using Decord and return normalized tensors with sampled frame indices
read_frames_cv2: read video frames using OpenCV and return normalized tensors with sampled frame indices
get_video_len: get the total number of frames in a video file using OpenCV
